qs.s: Sa mort a été un ___ terrible pour toute la famille.
qs.en: His death was a terrible blow for the whole family.

qs.s: Cette mauvaise nouvelle lui a porté un ___ dur.
qs.en: This bad news dealt him a hard blow.

qs.en: The boxer knocked his opponent to the ground with a single blow.

qs.s: Il a planté le clou d'un ___ de marteau.
qs.en: He drove the nail in with a hammer stroke.

qs.s: Elle a réussi l'examen du premier ___.
qs.en: She passed the exam at the first attempt.

qs.en: Each time, he made a new mistake.

qs.en: He thought he had planned everything; however, an unexpected event arose at the last moment.

qs.en: She found a gold ring in that old chest.
